description: webcontentpublisher.googleapis.com API, a service for web content publishers.
name: webcontentpublisher

fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

key.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

oauth_token.description: OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.

prettyPrint.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks.

quotaUser.description: Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.

parent.description: Required. The parent resource where this publication will be created. Format: `organizations/{organization}`.

publicationId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the publication to create. If not specified, the server will generate a random publication ID.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the publication to retrieve. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}`.

getSurveyQuestionCatalog.description: Retrieves the catalog of predefined survey questions and answer choices available for a publication.

languageCode.description: Optional. The BCP-47 language code (e.g., "en-US", "es-419") to override the publication's configured primary language.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the survey question catalog to retrieve. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}/surveyQuestionCatalog`.

filter.description: Optional. A filter expression to filter the publications returned.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of publications to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 publications will be returned.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListPublications` call, to retrieve the next page.

parent.description: Required. The parent organization whose publications to list, or "organizations/-" for all organizations a user has access to. Format: `organizations/{organization}`.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the publication. Format: organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}

updateMask.description: Optional. The list of fields to update.

ctaId.description: Optional. The unique identifier of the CTA to create. If not specified, the server will generate a random CTA ID.

parent.description: Required. The parent publication resource where this CTA will be created. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}`.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the CTA to retrieve. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}/ctas/{cta}`.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of CTAs to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 CTAs will be returned.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListCtas` call, to retrieve the next page.

parent.description: Required. The parent publication resource whose CTAs to list. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}`.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the Cta. Format: organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}/ctas/{cta}

updateMask.description: Optional. The list of fields to update.

checkFreeAccess.description: Checks if a user is eligible for free article access.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the publication. Format: publications/{publication_id}

uri.description: Required. The URI of the content.

generatePlatformSiteTokens.description: Returns user tokens mapped to their canonical domains for all publications the authenticated user is entitled to.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the user to generate tokens for. Format: users/{user}

categoryLabel.description: Output only. Text label used for aggregating responses by category in analytics.

displayText.description: Output only. Localized answer choice text displayed to readers.

id.description: Output only. Unique identifier of the answer choice within the question.

isAllowed.description: Output only. True if free access should be allowed, false otherwise.

ContentPolicyStatus.description: The content policy status of the publication, indicating any violations.

policyInfoUrl.description: Output only. URL pointing to more details about the policy violation or status.

state.description: Output only. The current policy state.
enumDescriptions: Content policy is in a good state; no violations.
The publication has a content policy violation but is within a grace period.
The publication has an active content policy violation.
The organization has a content policy violation but is within a grace period.
The organization has an active content policy violation.
The organization has an active content policy violation requiring immediate action.

Cta.description: Represents a Call-To-Action (CTA) configuration for a publication.

displayName.description: Required. The user-visible display name of the CTA.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the Cta. Format: organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}/ctas/{cta}

newsletterConfig.description: Optional. Configuration specific to newsletter signup CTAs. Only populated if type is `NEWSLETTER_SIGNUP`.

state.description: Output only. The current state of this CTA.
enumDescriptions: The CTA is a draft and not yet visible to users.
The CTA is active and visible to users.

surveyConfig.description: Optional. Configuration specific to survey CTAs. Only populated if type is `SURVEY`.

type.description: Required. The type of this CTA.

CustomAnswerChoice.description: An answer choice for a custom survey question.

displayText.description: Required. The display text of the answer choice shown to readers.

CustomQuestion.description: A custom question defined by the publisher.

answerChoices.description: Required. Ordered list of answer choices for the custom question (2-5 items).

categoryLabel.description: Optional. Reporting category label sent to Google Analytics (up to 100 characters).

displayText.description: Required. The question prompt displayed to readers.

id.description: Output only. Server-assigned unique identifier for the custom question.

DomainProperty.description: Represents a domain property associated with a publication, typically used to verify ownership and scope access.

ownershipVerified.description: Output only. Whether the domain ownership has been verified (e.g., via Google Search Console).

url.description: Required. The URL of the domain property (e.g., "https://example.com").

siteTokens.description: List of domain-scoped secure token mappings.

ctas.description: Output only. The list of CTAs.

nextPageToken.description: Output only. A token to retrieve the next page of results, or empty if there are no more results.
Output only. A token to retrieve the next page of results, or empty if there are no more results.

publications.description: Output only. The list of publications.

customConsentText.description: Optional. Custom consent or disclosure text shown to the user.

customMessage.description: Optional. A custom message displayed to the user in the signup prompt.

nameRequired.description: Optional. Whether the user is required to provide their name to sign up.

optInRequired.description: Optional. Whether checking the opt-in checkbox is required.

title.description: Required. The title of the newsletter signup prompt.

PresetQuestion.description: A preset question referencing a template in the survey question catalog.

answerIds.description: Optional. Selected answer choice IDs from the question template. Required (2-5 unique IDs) when the catalog question is `CONFIGURABLE_CHOICES`, and must be omitted for `FIXED_CHOICES`.

questionId.description: Required. ID of the question template from `SurveyQuestionCatalog`.

Publication.description: Represents a publisher's publication in Reader Revenue Manager.

additionalDomains.description: Optional. Additional domain properties verified for the publication.

contentPolicyStatus.description: Output only. The content policy compliance status of the publication.

displayName.description: Required. The user-visible display name of the publication.

languageCode.description: Required. The primary language of the publication (BCP-47 code, e.g., "en-US").

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the publication. Format: organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}

onboardingState.description: Output only. The current onboarding state.
enumDescriptions: Action is required from the publisher to proceed with onboarding.
Publication is pending an external verification step. No immediate action is required.

organizationId.description: Output only. The unique identifier of the organization that owns this publication.

paymentOption.description: Output only. The configured payment option.

primaryDomain.description: Required. The primary domain property associated with the publication.

products.description: Output only. The list of active products/features enabled for this publication.

publicationId.description: Output only. The unique identifier of the publication.

publicationPrivacyPolicyUrl.description: Optional. The URL to the publisher's Privacy Policy.

publicationTosUrl.description: Optional. The URL to the publisher's own Terms of Service.

publicationType.description: Optional. The publication entity type (for-profit vs non-profit). Defaults to FOR_PROFIT if omitted.

regionCode.description: Required. The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code where the publication is registered (e.g., "US").

rrmProduct.description: Optional. Reader Revenue Manager product settings and status.

QuestionTemplate.description: A predefined question template in the survey question catalog.

answerChoices.description: Output only. Possible answer choices for this question.

category.description: Output only. Category of the question based on the IAB Audience Taxonomy.
enumDescriptions: Demographic | Household Data | Number of Adults.
Demographic | Household Data | Number of Children.

categoryLabel.description: Output only. Text label used for aggregating responses by category in analytics.

configurationType.description: Output only. The type of answer choice configuration for this question.
enumDescriptions: Fixed set of answer choices for this question. Publishers are not able to select their own.
Publishers are able to select answer choices from `AnswerChoiceTemplate` for the question.

displayText.description: Output only. Localized question text displayed to readers.

id.description: Output only. Unique identifier of the question template.

RrmProduct.description: Configuration and status of the Reader Revenue Manager (RRM) product for a publication.

enabled.description: Optional. Whether the RRM product is enabled for the publication.

productTosUrl.description: Output only. The URL to the product-specific Terms of Service.

tosAcceptance.description: Optional. The details of the TOS acceptance.

SiteToken.description: Represents a domain-scoped secure token mapping.

domain.description: The domain scope this token is valid for.

SlProduct.description: Subscription Linking (SL) product settings and status.

enabled.description: Optional. Whether the Subscription Linking product is enabled.

gcpProjectNumber.description: Optional. The Google Cloud Project number associated with the publication.

customMessage.description: Optional. Header prompt shown to readers. If omitted, the server populates the default prompt localized to the parent publication's configured primary language.

questions.description: Optional. Ordered list of questions presented in the survey (1-3 items when `ACTIVE`; 0-3 when `DRAFT`).

SurveyQuestion.description: A single question within a survey, which can be either a preset question from the catalog or a custom publisher-defined question.

customQuestion.description: Optional. A custom question defined by the publisher.

presetQuestion.description: Optional. A question selected from the preset question catalog.

SurveyQuestionCatalog.description: Represents the catalog of predefined survey questions and localized answer choices available for a publication.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the survey question catalog. Format: `organizations/{organization}/publications/{publication}/surveyQuestionCatalog`.

questions.description: Output only. The list of available predefined question templates.

TosAcceptance.description: Details about the acceptance of the Terms of Service (TOS).

emailOptIn.description: Optional. Whether the user opted in to receive product updates and email communications.

userAccepted.description: Required. Whether the user has accepted the Terms of Service.
